column1: # Solar system data for SDT orbital mechanics validation
# SDT uses k_factor (Ϟ) directly - no beta
# - R: Radius (m) - for primary bodies; 0 for satellites/orbits
# - a: Semi-major axis (m) - distance from primary body
# - v_orbital: Orbital velocity (m/s) - calculated from v = 2πa/T
# - k_factor: SDT k-factor (Ϟ) - primary's k_factor for satellites
# - SDT_predicted_T: Predicted period from SDT (s) - T = 2πϞ√(a³/R)/c
# - Error: Percentage error between observed and predicted period
# All calculations shown in detail in: tools/planetary_calculations_detailed.txt
# Status: Real observational data from JPL ephemerides and NASA PDS
